# Fabric manifest fields

<!-- Generated by ManifestDocs.UpToDate from fabric_manifest_fields.hpp. Do not edit: see README.md, "Regenerating FIELDS.md". -->

Every field the manifest records, with the named compile-time argument that feeds it, and the named arguments
and defines it leaves out. [README.md](README.md) explains the shape they fit into.

## Fields

### Router fields

`routers.<key>.fields`

| Key | Kind | Schema | Category | Fed as | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `edm_status` | l1 | `enum:EDMStatus` | lifecycle | `EDM_STATUS_PTR_ADDR` | How far the router has come through startup and teardown. |
| `termination_signal` | l1 | `enum:TerminationSignal` | lifecycle | `TERMINATION_SIGNAL_ADDR` | Where the router is told to stop. |
| `local_sync` | l1 | `u32` | lifecycle | `EDM_LOCAL_SYNC_PTR_ADDR` | The count the chip's routers sync through at startup: the others notify the master router, which then notifies them all. |
| `local_tensix_sync` | l1 | `u32` | lifecycle | `EDM_LOCAL_TENSIX_SYNC_PTR_ADDR` | The count the router waits on until its downstream tensix connections are ready. |
| `handshake` | l1 | `struct:handshake_info_t` | lifecycle | `HANDSHAKE_ADDR` | The Ethernet handshake scratch. Each end of the link writes its scratch into the first 16 bytes of the other's. |
| `handshake_sender` | flag |  | lifecycle | `IS_HANDSHAKE_SENDER` | Whether this end writes first: the sender repeats its write until the reply lands in its own scratch, and the receiver waits for the sender's write and then replies once. The two ends of a link differ. |
| `erisc_sync` | stream | `u32` in `remote_src` | lifecycle | `MULTI_RISC_TEARDOWN_SYNC_STREAM_ID` | The register the router's ERISCs sync through at startup and teardown, led by ERISC0. Unused when the router runs one ERISC. |
| `retrain_sync` | stream | `enum:CoordinatedEriscContextSwitchState` in `remote_src` | lifecycle | `ETH_RETRAIN_LINK_SYNC_STREAM_ID` | The register the router's ERISCs sync through to retrain the link, led by the ERISC that context switches. |
| `vc2_receiver_free_slots` | stream | `u32` in `buf_space_available` | flow_control | `VC2_RECEIVER_FREE_SLOTS_STREAM_ID` | The register reserved for the VC2 receiver's free slots, or the unused id when the router has no VC2. The router kernel declares it but does not read it. |
| `notify_worker_src` | l1 | `u32` | flow_control | `NOTIFY_WORKER_OF_READ_COUNTER_UPDATE_SRC_ADDR` | Where the router stages the source of the inline write that updates a producer's read counter. Allocated only on Blackhole. |
| `my_direction` | enum | `enum:eth_chan_directions` | kernel_params | `MY_DIRECTION` | The direction the router faces, which the kernel picks its downstream channels and free-slot registers by. The router's key uses ControlPlane's direction. |
| `wait_for_host_signal` | flag |  | kernel_params | `WAIT_FOR_HOST_SIGNAL` | Whether the router takes part in the chip's startup sync through local_sync. Without it, the kernel ignores its local sync arguments. |
| `idle_context_switching` | flag |  | kernel_params | `IDLE_CONTEXT_SWITCHING` | Whether the router context switches only once idle, rather than every interval. |
| `context_switch_interval` | number |  | kernel_params | `SWITCH_INTERVAL` | How many main loop iterations go by between context switches to base firmware; with idle_context_switching, how many in a row without progress. |
| `handshake_context_switch_timeout` | number |  | kernel_params | `DEFAULT_HANDSHAKE_CONTEXT_SWITCH_TIMEOUT` | How many writes the handshake sender makes before it gives base firmware a turn to route, and then starts counting again. |
| `txq_spin_wait_send_data` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ETH_TXQ_SPIN_WAIT_SEND_NEXT_DATA` | Whether a data send spins until the Ethernet TX queue is free, instead of skipping the send while it is busy. |
| `txq_spin_wait_completion_ack` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ETH_TXQ_SPIN_WAIT_RECEIVER_SEND_COMPLETION_ACK` | The same, for a receiver's completion ack. |
| `txq_accept_ahead` | number |  | kernel_params | `DEFAULT_NUM_ETH_TXQ_DATA_PACKET_ACCEPT_AHEAD` | How many packets each Ethernet TX queue accepts before the earlier ones are sent. Written to both queues' ETH_TXQ_DATA_PACKET_ACCEPT_AHEAD register at startup. |
| `risc_cpu_data_cache` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ENABLE_RISC_CPU_DATA_CACHE` | Whether the kernel treats the RISC's data cache as on, and so invalidates it before reading what other cores write to its L1. |
| `speedy_vc0` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ENABLE_SPEEDY_VC0` | Whether VC0 runs the speedy path: worker-only steps that pass credits in batches, so a credit count can lag the packet count by up to a batch. |
| `sender_credit_amortization` | number |  | kernel_params | `SENDER_CREDIT_AMORTIZATION_FREQUENCY` | Speedy VC0 only: the sender reads completions once this many packets are outstanding, and returns credits to its producer once this many have completed. |
| `receiver_credit_amortization` | number |  | kernel_params | `RECEIVER_CREDIT_AMORTIZATION_FREQUENCY` | Speedy VC0 only: the receiver acks completions to the peer's sender in batches of at least this many packets. |
| `perf_telemetry` | l1 | `bytes` | diagnostics | `PERF_TELEMETRY_BUFFER_ADDR` | Where the router records its bandwidth telemetry, when bandwidth telemetry is on. Allocated only then, except on Blackhole, which always allocates it. |
| `code_profiling` | l1 | `struct:CodeProfilingTimerResult` | diagnostics | `CODE_PROFILING_BUFFER_ADDR` | Where the router accumulates each code profiling timer's cycles and captures, one result per timer type. Allocated only with code profiling on. |
| `channel_trimming_capture_enabled` | flag |  | diagnostics | `ENABLE_CHANNEL_TRIMMING_RESOURCE_USAGE_CAPTURE` | Whether the router records which of its channels carry traffic, for a later run to trim the unused ones. |
| `channel_trimming_capture` | l1 | `struct:FabricDatapathUsageL1Results` | diagnostics | `RESOURCE_USAGE_CAPTURE_OUTPUT_L1_ADDRESS` (with the channel trimming capture on) | Where it records them: the packet sizes each sender channel saw, and which sender and receiver channels carried traffic. |

### ERISC fields

`routers.<key>.eriscs.erisc<n>.fields`

| Key | Kind | Schema | Category | Fed as | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `local_handshake_master` | flag |  | lifecycle | `IS_LOCAL_HANDSHAKE_MASTER` | Whether this ERISC leads the chip's startup sync (the chip's local_sync). The kernel reads it only with wait_for_host_signal. |
| `handshake_enabled` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ENABLE_ETHERNET_HANDSHAKE` | Whether this ERISC runs the Ethernet handshake with the peer at startup. |
| `context_switch_enabled` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ENABLE_CONTEXT_SWITCH` | Whether this ERISC hands control back to base firmware. |
| `interrupts_enabled` | flag |  | kernel_params | `ENABLE_INTERRUPTS` | Whether this ERISC is configured with interrupts on. The router kernel declares it but does not read it. |
| `teardown_check_iterations` | number |  | kernel_params | `ITERATIONS_BETWEEN_CTX_SWITCH_AND_TEARDOWN_CHECKS` | How many passes over its channel steps the main loop makes between its checks for termination and context switching. |
| `telemetry_stats_mask` | number |  | kernel_params | `FABRIC_TELEMETRY_STATS_MASK` | The FabricTelemetryStatistic bits this ERISC collects; 0 when its telemetry is off. |

### Sender channel fields

`routers.<key>.channels.senders.vc<v>.ch<c>.fields`

| Key | Kind | Schema | Category | Fed as | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `is_injection_channel` | flag |  | flow_control | `SENDER_CH_{}_IS_INJECTION` | Whether the channel injects traffic into the fabric. With deadlock avoidance on, an injection channel uses bubble flow control. |
| `free_slots` | stream | `u32` in `buf_space_available` | flow_control | `SENDER_CHANNEL_{}_FREE_SLOTS_STREAM_ID` | The channel's free slots: the producer takes one per packet it writes, and the router returns it once the packet completes. |
| `producer_credit_return_noc` | number |  | flow_control | `SENDER_CH_{}_ACK_NOC_ID` | The NoC the router returns the producer's credits on. |
| `producer_credit_return_cmd_buf` | enum | `enum:NocCmdBuf` | flow_control | `SENDER_CH_{}_ACK_CMD_BUF_ID` | The NoC command buffer it returns them through. |
| `connection` | l1 | `u32` | control_info | a runtime argument | Where the producer opens and closes its connection. In the router's runtime args. |
| `conn_info` | l1 | `struct:EDMChannelWorkerLocationInfo` | control_info | `LOCAL_SENDER_CH_{}_CONN_INFO_ADDR` | Where the producer writes where it is, and the router its read counter. |
| `buffer_index_sem` | l1 | `struct:SenderChannelProducerCursor` | control_info | a runtime argument | Where the producer keeps its write cursor across connections. In the producer's runtime args, from the channel's connection spec. |
| `static_connection` | flag |  | control_info | `SENDER_CH_{}_WAIT_STATIC_CONNECTION` | Whether a sibling router connects to the channel once, at startup: before its main loop, the router waits for that connection. |

### Receiver channel fields

`routers.<key>.channels.receivers.vc<v>.ch<c>.fields`

| Key | Kind | Schema | Category | Fed as | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `forwarding_disabled` | flag |  | kernel_params | `DISABLE_RX_CH{}_FORWARDING` | Whether the receiver's step skips handing its packets on, to siblings or the local chip. Set for the speedy VC0 and VC2 steps, which hand packets on themselves, and when a channel trimming capture saw the channel do neither. |
| `intermesh_ingress` | flag |  | kernel_params | `IS_RECEIVER_CHANNEL_{}_INTERMESH_INGRESS` (2D only) | Whether the receiver's packets arrive from another mesh: the kernel re-encodes their route from this mesh's route table before deciding where they go. |
| `forward_noc` | number |  | kernel_params | `RX_CH_{}_FWD_NOC_ID` | The NoC the receiver forwards packets to sibling routers on. |
| `forward_data_cmd_buf` | enum | `enum:NocCmdBuf` | kernel_params | `RX_CH_{}_FWD_DATA_CMD_BUF_ID` | The NoC command buffer it writes each forwarded packet through. |
| `forward_sync_cmd_buf` | enum | `enum:NocCmdBuf` | kernel_params | `RX_CH_{}_FWD_SYNC_CMD_BUF_ID` | The NoC command buffer it sends the credit increment that announces a forwarded packet through. |
| `local_write_noc` | number |  | kernel_params | `RX_CH_{}_LOCAL_WRITE_NOC_ID` | The NoC the receiver delivers packets to the local chip on. |
| `local_write_cmd_buf` | enum | `enum:NocCmdBuf` | kernel_params | `RX_CH_{}_LOCAL_WRITE_CMD_BUF_ID` | The NoC command buffer it delivers them through. |
| `pkts_sent` | stream | `u32` in `buf_space_available` | flow_control | `TO_RECEIVER_{}_PKTS_SENT_ID` | The packets the peer's sender has sent the channel that the receiver has not taken yet: the peer adds one per packet it sends over Ethernet. |
